name: cn-1688-wholesale-listing
description: Write a wholesale listing for 1688: a buyer-searchable title, tiered pricing and minimum order quantity, factory and supply-capacity proof, customisation and OEM terms, one-piece dropshipping terms, packaging and delivery details, and the trade terms a purchaser checks before enquiring. Use when asked 写 1688 标题, 1688 详情页怎么做, 设置起批量和阶梯价, 一件代发怎么写, 工厂店铺介绍, or write a 1688 product page. Produces a title, a price ladder, a supply-capability block, a detail page outline for wholesale buyers, customisation terms, an enquiry reply template and a compliance check. Distinct from cn-ecommerce-listing, which is for consumer marketplaces.
